card.name: Words just before "money" (money order)
card.fires_on: Linking words or commas right before "money", mostly in "check or money order" in payment lists. It also fires on "anti" before a hyphen and on a few other places.

modes.label: Payment list before money order
modes.description: The "or" or comma in a list of payment methods, just before "money order".
modes.example: can be paid using a major credit card, check,<< or>> money order.

modes.label: Anti before a hyphen
modes.description: The prefix "anti" in drug or antibody terms, before a hyphen.
modes.example: the results of any prior or subsequent<< anti>>-JCV antibody testing.

modes.label: Other money-related lists
modes.description: A linking word in a list in fraud or crime text where money terms may follow.
modes.example: victims of fraud or future victims of trafficking, money laundering,<< or>> sexual or physical exploitation
